_about: Skyscrapers layer (150 m+). engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches the Wikipedia list; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/toronto/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Facts below are our own wording, checked against the sources noted.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in Toronto

exclude.CN Tower: A communications tower, not a building; it stays on Landmarks.

coords._why: Nominatim has no house number 4800 on Yonge; the site is the southwest corner of Yonge and Sheppard (UrbanToronto, December 2025).

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out. Checked October 10, 2026.

SkyTower at Pinnacle One Yonge: Tallest building in Canada, and the first in the country with more than 100 floors
One Bloor West: Briefly Canada's tallest building, 2025–2026, until SkyTower overtook it
First Canadian Place: Tallest building in Canada for half a century, 1975–2025
When it opened, the tallest building in the world outside New York and Chicago
